channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Anthropic IPO raises over $81 billion in largest offering on record, topping SpaceX
item.description: Anthropic stock is set to begin trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ANT on Thursday.

item.title: Trump says U.S., China, Russia ‘uniquely positioned’ to discuss reducing nuclear weapons at historic meeting
item.description: The leaders of the U.S., China and Russia met in Shenzhen on Thursday for a rare trilateral gathering.

item.title: Musk accuses Zelenskyy of lying about Starshield restrictions in Ukraine
item.description: Elon Musk was asked about Zelenskyy claims over the Starshield network, and he said, "I don't want to blow your mind, but Zelenskyy is not always truthful."

item.title: Takaichi gets chilly reception in China on first Japan leader visit since 2019
item.description: Takaichi received a subdued welcome on her trip to attend the APEC summit, as Beijing shows limited appetite for repairing ties strained by Taiwan dispute.

item.title: Nvidia interim CEO Kress tells employees ‘let’s move forward’ at first all-hands meeting since Jensen Huang exit
item.description: Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress urges staff forward and offers pay raises after Jensen Huang exit.

item.title: Trump praises ‘great relationship’ with Putin after meeting, as Ukraine war takes center stage
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump met individually on Thursday with Russian President Vladimir Putin, as well as Chinese President Xi Jinping.

item.title: Musk says Jensen Huang is irreplaceable, regrets midterm spending
item.description: Elon Musk spoke about Jensen Huang, his U.S. midterms spending and overlaps between SpaceX and Tesla at the Dealbook Summit.

item.title: APEC final day in photos: Trump, Xi and Putin shake hands; Takaichi kept at a distance
item.description: Leaders gathered Thursday for the second day of the economic summit, ahead of a historic trilateral meeting between the U.S., Russia and China.

item.title: I watched Trump, Xi and Putin gather in China. Here are my top takeaways
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin are expected to hold a rare trilateral meeting on Thursday.

item.title: Cantor Fitzgerald's Nvidia business interests targeted in Democrats' Lutnick probe
item.description: The congressional probe is among the first to be announced since the blue-wave midterm that will deliver Democrats control of the House and Senate come January.

item.title: Palo Alto inks $4.5 billion deal for AI startup Applied Compute, shares pop 7% on earnings
item.description: Palo Alto Networks has been steadily acquiring companies to capitalize on demand for cyber tools to fight AI.

item.title: 'Parasite' backer and other South Korean media, gaming and travel stocks rally on China trade deal
item.description: Korean media, gaming and travel stocks surged on hopes of greater access to China.

item.title: Kash Patel skips House hearing after Mar-a-Lago gala with $50,000 access
item.description: Kash Patel missed a congressional hearing after appearing the night before at a Mar-a-Lago gala offering donors of $50,000 access to top officials.

item.title: CEO turned informant: How the FDA built a case against executives promising cheap medications
item.description: The FDA's unprecedented criminal case against an alternative funding program hinged on the cooperation of a peer CEO, according to a court record.

item.title: Fed officials expect more rate hikes, worry about AI impact on inflation, minutes show
item.description: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday released minutes from its October policy meeting at which it voted to hold its benchmark interest rate in a range between 3.75%-4%.

item.title: Big bets against AI debt, from CoreWeave to Oracle and the Mag 7, could soon hit the ETF market
item.description: Investor fears about AI balance sheets and debt are running high, especially for neoclouds. ETFs targeting the credit default swaps of AI issuers are coming.

item.title: Why Anthropic's hot IPO is bringing out sellers — plus, a silver lining of the down market
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: Retail investor enthusiasm for Anthropic IPO to rival SpaceX debut
item.description: Anthropic is gearing up for a blockbuster initial public offering this week, and excitement among retail investors looks to be off the charts.

item.title: Investigators make progress in hunt for cause of FAA ground stop
item.description: Engineers and analysts are still searching for the root cause of the issue, which led to a four-hour ground stop on Friday.

item.title: One of the world's most contested seas is proving too much for Asia's leaders to resolve
item.description: The ASEAN summit in the Philippines failed to conclude the Code of Conduct for the South China Sea despite Manila pledging it would happen this year.

item.title: Vance scraps schedule to address tech outages as Trump admin insists incidents aren't linked
item.description: Recent disruptions include a nationwide ground stop, Microsoft Outlook outage and a reported blackout of the National Security Agency's communications network.

item.title: Inside India newsletter: Foreign flows helped the market recover. Now it faces the inflation test
item.description: India’s inflation, which has been on the rise for 12 straight months, is becoming a risk to growth and to the reversal of foreign inflows.

item.title: Fed’s Waller says central bank may need to ‘shock people’ with half-point rate hike
item.description: Continued inflation above the Fed's 2% target is pushing central bank officials into a more aggressive stance.

item.title: Is Apple the safe haven investors think it is? Here's a way to trade it with less risk
item.description: Traders have flocked to Apple's perceived safety in the wake of Nvidia's scandal. It may not be so safe, says Mike Khouw

item.title: Read Jim Cramer’s full interview with Nvidia’s Colette Kress: Demand, buybacks and China
item.description: Interim CEO Kress sat down with CNBC’s Jim Cramer Tuesday evening shortly after the AI chip giant delivered a quarterly beat and strong guidance.

item.title: Ford starts U.S. battery cell production using Chinese tech amid geopolitical tensions
item.description: Ford has started U.S. production and shipments of battery cells for its next-generation EVs using technologies licensed by Chinese battery giant CATL.

item.title: Two new housing reports point to bleak winter ahead, with record low sales
item.description: Two new reports on the state of the housing market show things are just getting worse, as high mortgage rates and inflation plague builders and buyers.

item.title: Tech outages are causing people to panic-buy. Costco is benefiting, Mizuho says
item.description: Shoppers are spending more at Costco as tech outages turn into a race to get emergency goods.

item.title: Nvidia’s Kress faces a divided workforce as some employees push for Huang’s return
item.description: Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress calmed investors. Now she has to calm employees.

item.title: Jeffries wins Democratic House speaker race, on track to make history in January
item.description: Jeffries will still need to win a floor vote in January to officially become House speaker.
